column6: It is very surprising that children of this age already know how to show their skills on these things.

column2: Three old white women are looking at photos on display.
column3: What photos are they looking at?
column4: Maybe they are photos from their younger years.
column5: When people grow old, they remember a lot the things that happened when they were young.
column6: They all seem to have lived full lives.
